text:
Alex (CSM): quick health check for Acme — noticed model mix shifted heavily toward rdx-large-v2 after yesterday's canary. overall usage up 18% week-over-week, spend +22%. fallback rate increased, need eyes. :eyes:
Maria (CSM): thanks — renewal in 6 weeks, want to avoid surprises. do we have per-route fallback breakdown? especially /chat-stream and /summary routes. :warning:
Kevin (Data): pulling numbers from console now. short summary: rdx-large-v2 = 61.8%, rdx-medium = 29.1%, legacy-small = 9.1%. overall fallback_rate = 5.2% (24h). but important: /chat-stream fallback = 11.9% during 09:00-11:30 UTC spike. /summary fallback ~1.3%. p50 latency for /chat-stream went 140ms -> 260ms after canary. p95 spiked 520ms -> 1.1s.
Sam (Infra): saw GPU queue build on one dedicated pool around the same window. concurrent_inflight_requests increased ~35%. looks like rdx-large-v2 memory/kv cache pattern causing stalls for long chats.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout to rdx-large-v2 at 20% completed at 2026-03-19T09:16:02Z. Auto-escalation triggered at 10:48: rollout paused, alert sent to infra.
Alex (CSM): so fallbacks are mostly to rdx-medium, not to cached responses. that implies latency or OOM on large model rather than bad prompt handling. Maria — do we want to pause further expansion?
Maria (CSM): yes, please limit to 10% until we root cause. also want an action list we can share with Acme before renewal call.
Kevin (Data): action items I can own: 1) attach per-customer per-route breakdown CSV (will post in thread) 2) run the eval set against rdx-large-v2 for 50 representative prompts to check regressions 3) flag any token inflation patterns.
Sam (Infra): infra actions: 1) enable prefix/KV caching for /chat-stream on Acme's account (toggle) 2) reduce canary weight to 10% and re-run with concurrency cap 3) check allocator logs for OOMs and kernel timeouts.
Alex (CSM): great. tentative timeline: Kevin drops CSV by EOD, Sam toggles KV cache now and drops note when live, we keep canary at 10% until Friday morning. Maria will prep a short note for Acme summarizing mitigation and ask to postpone increasing usage-heavy tests until after next week.
Maria (CSM): adding: please include cost delta estimation if they stay on rdx-large-v2 at current weights — we should be transparent on spend impact. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Kevin (Data): cost delta estimate: roughly +28% token-cost for generation routes based on tok/sec model, but effective spend may be higher due to extra retries from fallbacks. I'll include both nominal and retry-inflated estimates.
Alex (CSM): thanks everyone. I'll own the customer message. tagging for visibility: Sam (Infra) @Sam (Infra), Kevin (Data) @Kevin (Data). we'll reconvene in this thread after CSV and cache toggle. :thumbsup:
